svg.title: rEach alone and rEach with Teach
svg.desc: A side-by-side comparison across seven capabilities: identity, rules, checks, evidence, record, proof and help. Alone, rEach is a careful assistant with nobody to answer to. With Teach, each capability closes into a loop the agent cannot grade itself in.
svg.text: rEach alone is a careful assistant with nobody to answer to. Teach is what makes its promises checkable.
every promise rests on the student's own computer
every promise has someone on the other side to check it
Anyone can install it. Nobody knows who is doing the work.
The roster confirms the student, the enrollment is tied to their computer and
Rules are local files that the machine's owner can edit.
Rules arrive signed by the instructors. Unsigned or stale rules stop the work.
An agent can only pass the checks it can see, and can tune to them.
Hidden checks run on the server, where the agent can neither read nor tune to
Seals and ledgers are written, and nobody ever reads them.
The server reads the seal and the witness ledger when it weighs where work
Nobody sees how the work was actually done.
De-identified assignment conversations reach the instructors, who can read how
"Submitted" is only a claim on the student's own computer.
A signed receipt proves what arrived and when. The due time is kept on the
A stuck student stays stuck, and no one finds out.
Hands, fault reports and notes reach the instructors, who answer, live if
The mechanisms behind the glass are private. The guarantees are public.
